prompt: 我想科学地对比两个版本的 system prompt——v1 是简单的角色定义，v2 增加了 chain-of-thought 和 few-shot examples。需要一个 A/B 测试框架，能量化哪个版本更好，包括统计显著性检验。

assertions.description: Provides a structured A/B comparison framework for prompt versions
Defines weighted scoring dimensions (quality, format, safety, performance, cost)
Includes statistical significance test (paired comparison, confidence interval)
Provides a concrete scoring rubric with criteria per dimension
